verdict.rationale: Braintrust docs show clear mechanisms to pull data out programmatically: `bt view logs` can download logs as CSV or JSON or sync locally via `bt sync pull` (docs-35), and the full REST API lets you manage/export projects, experiments, datasets and logs (docs-34, docs-41). However, there is no evidence of a native, purpose-built bulk-export pipeline to blob storage (S3/GCS) or a data warehouse (Snowflake/BigQuery) — self-hosting only relocates storage location, it isn't an export feature (docs-10, docs-24, docs-32). missing for 10: native connectors/integrations for direct export to blob storage or data warehouses, documentation of large-scale/bulk export workflows, and independent confirmation of these export paths working at scale.
